newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-BECKER WITHDRAWS FROM EUROPEAN COMMUNITY EVENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER WITHDRAWS FROM EUROPEAN COMMUNITY EVENT.

text.p: Boris Becker pulled out of the European Community tennis championship on Tuesday because of tendinitis, an ATP spokeswoman said.
"Boris Becker pulled out, just now. He has...tendinitis in the wrist," she said.

Tournament director Georges Baudeweyns said on Monday that former Wimbledon champion Becker had recovered from the wrist injury which forced him out of last week's Dubai Open and would compete in Antwerp.
The injury caused the German to withdraw in Dubai minutes before his quarter-final against Goran Ivanisevic last Friday.
Becker, who was scheduled to face Czech Petr Korda in the first round on Wednesday, will be replaced by lucky loser Dennis van Scheppingen of the Netherlands.
